name: modred-coding-tracker
description: Tracks active coding time and reports it to your personal dashboard.

modred.apiUrl.description: Base URL of your Modred tracker API (no trailing slash).

modred.apiToken.description: Bearer token for authenticating with your tracker API. Prefer setting MODRED_TRACKER_TOKEN as an environment variable instead of storing it here in plain settings.

modred.dashboardUrl.description: URL opened by 'Modred: Open Activity Dashboard' (defaults to <apiUrl>/activity).

modred.idleThresholdMinutes.description: Minutes of no activity before a session is considered idle.

modred.heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: How often to send a heartbeat while actively coding.
